name: StepGrain2
description: Live-capture granular pad. Touch freezes up to 3 s of AUDIO IN. Grains fire on every 16th note with Probability. Length is 1/2/4/8/16 steps. Fade is an inside attack/release. Shimmer mixes +1 oct first, then +2 oct. Mix is a volume blend. Spread / Reverse.

params.name: Fade
params.detail: Inside attack and release, 0–100%. 0% keeps a few samples of edge. 100% makes attack and release each half of the grain, with no flat middle. Default 50%.

params.name: Probability
params.detail: Probability that a grain fires on each 16th note. The clock is fixed at 1 step. Default 100%.

params.name: Mix
params.detail: Volume blend of live input and grains.

params.name: Length
params.detail: Grain length: 1, 2, 4, 8, or 16 steps. Default 1 Step.

params.name: Shimmer
params.detail: 0% is the original pitch. +1 oct enters first. +2 oct joins only toward the top. 100% is an equal 1/3 mix of original, +1, and +2. Default 100%.

params.name: Spread
params.detail: Random stereo width (0% = mono, 100% = hard L/R).

params.name: Reverse
params.detail: Probability that a grain plays in reverse (0–100%).
